title: preventive-plan.json
description: Authoritative shape for the preventive recommender's decision plan. Produced by skills/generate-preventive-recommend at .service-approval/<slug>/05-generate/preventive-plan.json. Consumed by the preventive authoring sub-skills (generate-preventive-scp/-rcp/-iam) and the root-cause critic. The plan is the gate: each GENERATE_* decision MUST carry a non-null anchor; ROUTE_DETECTIVE / REFER_TO_REFERENCE decisions carry no anchor. additionalProperties:false at top level and inside decisions[] to catch drift; permissive inside _metadata.

source_control_id.$comment: The originating control id from mapping-results.json that this decision implements. Cross-checked at validate time against mapping-results.json so an orphan decision (no matching control upstream) hard-fails.

plan_actions.$comment: The reviewed action set: the IAM actions the recommender deliberately intends this control's authored policy to gate. The root-cause critic rejects any authored Deny action absent from this set — an action the enforcing key happens to apply to but that was never reviewed is silent scope-creep. When omitted, the critic falls back to the mapping control's actions[].

citation.$comment: Typed citation for the intent source — what motivates the control. type==canopy: cite the Canopy mitigation alias in id. type==reference: cite the reference-repo example in id and url. type==catalog: cite the AWS Control Catalog ARN in id. type==service-doc: cite the AWS doc URL in url.

allOf.$comment: type==canopy MUST cite the mitigation alias in id.
Every GENERATE_* decision MUST carry a non-null anchor with an example_id — the repo-anchor gate.
ROUTE_DETECTIVE means not preventable and routed; no anchor.
